## Introduction: The Company of Strangers!

[How many strangers do you "meet"
everyday?]{style="background-color:yellow;"}

[Why is the Human Species different from all
others?]{style="background-color:yellow;"}

Those two questions are not unrelated !! The Human Species is perhaps
unique in that we are able to [cooperate with
strangers](https://fee.org/articles/book-reviews-september-2004/)

![](https://pup-assets.imgix.net/onix/images/9780691146461.jpg?w=410&auto=format){height="250px"
fig-align="center"}

Yes! Do you think that designing things, building and conducting a
business, or making art is something like that? No? Well, let us see a
few quick stories!!

### The Hero's Journey

<br>

<center>

<iframe src="https://www.google.com/maps/embed?pb=!1m34!1m12!1m3!1d5619597.823074568!2d2.755529685345978!3d46.54878964634841!2m3!1f0!2f0!3f0!3m2!1i1024!2i768!4f13.1!4m19!3e1!4m5!1s0x12a9d38abcf194c3%3A0x47bfee34eecc4749!2sTarbes%2C%20France!3m2!1d43.232951!2d0.078082!4m5!1s0x47e4eca0d3e2cca1%3A0x26a31399ffc66f20!2sMeung-sur-Loire%2C%2045130%2C%20France!3m2!1d47.827006999999995!2d1.6974319999999998!4m5!1s0x47e66e1f06e2b70f%3A0x40b82c3688c9460!2sParis%2C%20France!3m2!1d48.856614!2d2.3522219!5e0!3m2!1sen!2sin!4v1639201450428!5m2!1sen!2sin" width="700" height="450" style="border:0;" allowfullscreen loading="lazy">

This is the story of a young man who leaves home from Tarbes, in
Gascony, France, to travel to Paris to make his fortune. He has two sets of blessings, one each from his mother (an ointment to cure wounds) and his father (a horse, a sword, some money, and an [LOR](../../../../../materials/images/LOR-John-Nash.jpeg)). True to the
instructions given by his Dad, and his very Gascon nature, [he picks a
fight even before he reaches Paris.](https://youtu.be/KXvzAvOL5GI)

### Discussion-1

- Why are they TALKING, when they have come here to FIGHT?? ["When have
  to shoot, shoot! Don't
  talk!"](https://youtu.be/JrYtD7gSWsI?feature=shared) said [Eli
  Wallach](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eli_Wallach).
- Pardon,m'sieu, but why were they so polite to each other? Is this a *panga*, or not? (Oh, These
  French...)
- Were they talking **as if they didn't want to fight at all**?
- But to ["have fought already"]{style="background-color:yellow;"}?
- The **Shadow of the Future on the Present**

### Discussion-2

What **emotions** or **motivations** are portrayed by the characters in
the story? We can think of the "4Rs":

- Reward
- Regret aka FOMO
- Risk
- Retribution/Punishment

## [Wait, But Why?](https://waitbutwhy.com)

- Many public behaviours require us to *trust* strangers
- We have Rule of Law based on this trust
- If there is no **C** at first, then everybody does a **D**
- That is the source of the **Dilemma**
- As Artists and Designers, and Creators, we need to practice our craft
  that in such a way as to induce *niceness*...
- So what will you make? A movie? An ad? A public sign-board? A street
  play? An illustration? A "spatial arrangement"? A policy or a law?
  
## Design Situations with Game Theory?

- RWAs, pets, animals, and children. Sigh. 
- Public Spaces: Malls, Theaters, Trains, Busses...
- Street Traffic, Pedestrians, and Rules. (and Signage)
- Garbage, Littering, Noise...public (and not so public ) behaviour
- Families, Siblings, and Household Chores
- Parenting (Enough said.)
- Offices, Colleagues, and other pests

### Assignment-1

Take a walk in the nearest urban area this weekend. Unobtrusively,
observe what people are doing. Note these down when they seem to be
visible examples of "Cooperate" or "Defect". For or Against whom?
Discuss the Actions, and the possible payoff values. Draw up a Payoff
Matrix is possible. ( Some Actions will of course have to be "predicted"
since you do not observe the entire vocabulary of Actions they might
perform.)

Take no pictures.
